subject.title: feat: retain iMessage tombstones and revisions

question: Should existing `sync` invocations retain their replacement semantics, with merge retention exposed only through an explicit opt-in, or should v0.1 intentionally adopt merge-by-default despite the upgrade behavior change?
rationale: This is a persistent archive-policy and CLI-contract choice, not a mechanical correction: either direction defines what existing user archives mean after upgrade.

options.title: Keep replacement as the default
options.body: Retain current refresh semantics for existing commands and expose merge retention through an explicit new opt-in mode.

options.title: Adopt merge by default
options.body: Approve the new retention contract only with clear upgrade documentation and real proof that existing archives, source changes, and restore recovery behave as intended.

options.title: Pause the semantic change
options.body: Land only the independently safe parsing or schema work after separating it from the unresolved sync-policy change.

recommendation.title: Keep replacement as the default
recommendation.body: Retain current refresh semantics for existing commands and expose merge retention through an explicit new opt-in mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this contributor most directly to the proposed archive-sync contract and implementation; final product authority remains with repository maintainers.
